name: Outlaw
amenities: Full galley with refrigeration and prep space
Front lounge and private rear lounge
description: Outlaw is a custom Prevost X3-45 entertainer coach conversion configured with 12 bunks, a double slide layout and a master suite at the rear. Every booking includes a CDL-certified driver and 24/7 dispatch.
